'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict ]]
**[[2024 Haret Hreik airstrike]]
***[[Israel]] launches a missile attack on southern [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], killing at least four civilians and injuring 80 others. Senior [[Hezbollah]] commander [[Fuad Shukr]] is claimed by [[Israel]] to be the main target. He was in the area at the time of the attack, but his status is currently unknown. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/death-toll-from-israeli-strike-on-south-beirut-rises-to-4/3291038 (Anadolu Agency)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/7/30/israel-lebanon-tensions-live-israel-strikes-building-in-beirut-suburbs (Al Jazeera)]
**An Israeli civilian is killed in the [[HaGoshrim]] [[kibbutz]] by a rocket fired from Lebanon. [https://www.reuters.com/world/hezbollah-israel-conflict-not-inevitable-us-defense-secretary-says-2024-07-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian defense ministry]] says that its forces have taken control of the settlement of [[Pivdenne, Donetsk Oblast|Pivdenne]] in [[Donetsk region]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-its-forces-took-control-pivdenne-eastern-ukraine-2024-07-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Attempted assassination of Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]]
***[[Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]], the [[military junta]] leader of [[Sudan]], survives an assassination attempt carried out with a [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] while he was visiting a military base in Gibet. Five people are killed. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20240731-sudan-army-chief-burhan-survives-assassination-attempt/ (Middle East Monitor)]
*[[2024 Southport riot]]
**Riots occur in response to [[2024 Southport stabbing|a previous mass stabbing]] in [[Southport]], [[Merseyside]]. The right-wing [[English Defence League]] was present in front of a mosque, despite not having existed for over a decade. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/article/2024/jul/31/three-arrested-over-southport-riots (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria during the Israel–Hamas war]]
**The [[United States]] carries out an airstrike near [[Hillah]], [[Iraq]], killing four members of Iraq's [[Popular Mobilization Units]]. Iraq condemns the strike, saying the [[Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve|US-led military coalition]] committed a "heinous crime" by targeting security sites and said the attacks were a serious violation of the coalition's mission and mandate. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/explosions-iraqs-pmf-security-agency-base-south-baghdad-kill-one-member-sources-2024-07-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[President of Angola|Angolan President]] [[João Lourenço]] announces that the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] and [[Rwanda]] have agreed to a [[ceasefire]] following [[Angola]]-mediated talks. [https://www.trtafrika.com/africa/ceasefire-reached-in-eastern-drc-18189698 (TRT Afrika)]
*[[Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency]]
**The [[Ministry of National Defense (Turkey)|Turkish defense ministry]] says that it targeted [[Kurdistan Workers' Party|Kurdish militants]] in northern [[Iraq]] with air strikes, killing 13 people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkey-says-it-killed-13-kurdish-militants-northern-iraq-2024-07-30/ (Reuters)]
*Unidentified gunmen open fire on a bulletproof vehicle carrying local staff working for a [[United Nations]] [[United Nations Development Programme|development agency]] in [[Dera Ismail Khan]], [[Pakistan]]. No casualties have been reported. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/gunmen-open-fire-on-a-vehicle-carrying-un-staff-in-northwest-pakistan-no-casualties/articleshow/112137504.cms (''TOI'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tesla, Inc.|Tesla]] recalls more than 1.8 million vehicles due to a hood issue that could increase the risk of a crash. An [[Over-the-air update|over-the-air]] software update for the issue was made available in June. [https://qz.com/tesla-recall-electric-vehicles-models-hood-issues-nhtsa-1851608569 (Quartz)]
*[[Rex Airlines]], [[Australia]]'s third-largest airline, suspends all domestic [[Boeing 737]] flights and enters [[voluntary administration]]. [https://www.afr.com/companies/transport/rex-grounds-city-flights-virgin-steps-in-to-rescue-passengers-20240730-p5jxqz (''AFR'')]
*[[Spain]]'s [[Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia|competition watchdog]] fines online travel agency [[Booking.com]] with a record €413 million fine for "abusing its dominant position" in the past five years. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240730-spain-watchdog-fines-booking-com-413-mn-euros (France 24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Gaemi]]
***The death toll from torrential rains and [[flood]]s caused by remnants of Typhoon Gaemi in [[Hunan]], [[China]], increases to 22. [https://ca.news.yahoo.com/china-reports-7-more-deaths-055422462.html (Yahoo! Canada)]
*[[2024 Gaza Strip polio epidemic]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] reports that it is now "very likely" that [[poliovirus]] has infected [[Palestinians|Gazan citizens]] and is spreading among the population. The statement was released shortly after the [[Gaza Health Ministry]] declared a polio [[epidemic]] in the territory. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/polio-cases-very-likely-gaza-population-who-says-2024-07-30/ (Reuters)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/gaza-health-ministry-declares-territory-polio-epidemic-area-24da98d1 (''Barron's'')]
*[[2024 Wayanad landslides]] 
**At least 162 people are killed, 191 others are injured, and more than 89 others are missing in [[landslide]]s in [[Wayanad district]], [[Kerala]], [[India]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/thiruvananthapuram/wayanad-landslide-news-live-updates-hundreds-feared-trapped-govt-launches-massive-rescue-operation/liveblog/112122036.cms (''The Times of India'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/30/several-feared-dead-hundreds-trapped-after-landslides-hit-indias-kerala (Al Jazeera)]
*A helicopter crashes near [[Killucan and Rathwire|Killucan]], [[County Westmeath]], [[Ireland]], killing two people. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2024/0730/1462669-helicopter-crash/ (RTÉ)]
*Five people are killed and nine others are injured when a boat capsizes on the [[Nile River]] in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1235/528121/Egypt/Urban--Transport/UPDATED-Egyptians,-Saudis-among--casualties-in-Cai.aspx (''Al Ahram'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Algeria–France relations]], [[Political status of Western Sahara]]
**[[Algeria]] withdraws its ambassador from [[France]] after France declared its support for the [[Western Sahara Autonomy Proposal]], which was proposed by [[Morocco]] in 2007. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20240730-algeria-recalls-ambassador-after-france-backs-moroccan-plan-for-western-sahara (RFI)]
*[[Armenia–Turkey relations]]
**[[Turkey]] and [[Armenia]] resume talks aimed at normalizing diplomatic relations and agree to simplify visa rules for some passport holders. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/07/30/turkey-armenia-make-progress-in-normalization-talks (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Foreign relations of Afghanistan]]
**The [[Taliban]] suspends relations with 14 [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] overseas diplomatic missions and announces that they will no longer accept consular documents issued by these missions. [https://www.rferl.org/a/taliban-diplomatic-missions-afghanistan/33056291.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan relations]]
**[[Kyrgyzstan]] says that 94% of [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|its border with Tajikistan]] has been agreed upon by officials from both countries. [https://www.rferl.org/a/kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-border-demarcation-delimitation/33056219.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Philippines–United States relations]]
**[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] announces the allocation of $500 million to [[Military budget of the United States|fund]] the [[Armed Forces of the Philippines|Philippine military]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-announces-500-million-for-philippine-defenses/a-69806093 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan protests]]
**[[Freddy Superlano]], a leading figure in [[Venezuela]]'s opposition coalition, is arrested as the death toll from ongoing anti-[[Nicolás Maduro|Maduro]] protests increases to four. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/07/30/death-toll-rises-to-four-in-anti-maduro-protests-in-venezuela (Al Arabiya)]
*[[American Indian boarding school gravesites]]
**A federal investigation commissioned by [[United States Secretary of the Interior|U.S. Interior Secretary]] [[Deb Haaland]] discovers that sixty-five [[American Indian boarding schools|federal American Indian boarding school]] sites have [[Unmarked grave|unmarked]] or marked [[Grave|gravesites]], and confirms that "at least" 973 [[Native Americans in the United States|Native American]] children died at boarding schools, primarily from abuse and illness. [https://apnews.com/article/indian-boarding-schools-deaths-investigation-82645234fe9d7ce689e8375a51d7e161 (AP)]
*[[United Kingdom|British]] Islamic preacher [[Anjem Choudary]] is sentenced to [[Life imprisonment in England and Wales|life in prison]] with a minimum sentence of 28 years for directing the [[al-Muhajiroun]] militant network. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/radical-british-preacher-anjem-choudary-sentenced-life-prison-112397501 (ABC News)]
*[[Interpol]] announces that more than 200 people have been arrested and more than US$1.6 billion of illegal drugs and precursor chemicals seized as part of a two-month operation against narcotics trafficking conducted across [[Europe]], [[North America]], and [[Africa]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/interpol-anti-narcotics-operation-leads-206-arrests-seizure-112392660 (ABC News)]
*[[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] pardons a [[Germany|German]] citizen on [[Capital punishment in Belarus|death row]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/belarus-pardons-german-man-facing-execution-state-media-eb9cdafe (''Barron's'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Iranian presidential election]]
**[[Masoud Pezeshkian]] is inaugurated as the ninth [[president of Iran]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240730-iran-s-president-pezeshkian-sworn-in-at-parliament (France 24)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Summer Olympics]]
**[[Concerns and controversies at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***Olympic officials postpone the men's individual [[Triathlon at the 2024 Summer Olympics|triathlon]] race due to poor water quality levels in the [[Seine]] river. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/07/29/sport/seine-pollution-olympics-triathlon-postponed-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
***Several athletes test positive for [[COVID-19]], including [[Australia]]n swimmer [[Lani Pallister]], forcing her to withdraw from the [[Swimming at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's 1500 metre freestyle|1500 metre freestyle swimming]] event. [https://english.alarabiya.net/sports/2024/07/30/covid-19-looms-over-2024-paris-olympics-with-several-athletes-testing-positive (Al Arabiya)]
**[[Brazil at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Brazil]] wins a bronze medal in [[Gymnastics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's artistic team all-around|women's artistic gymnastics team competition]], their first ever medal in the event. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240730-biles-queen-but-italy-brazil-make-history-with-team-medals (France 24)]
**[[United States at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***The [[United States]] wins a bronze medal in women's [[Rugby sevens|rugby]], their first ever medal in the [[Rugby sevens at the 2024 Summer Olympics|sport at the Olympics]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/sports/usa-womens-rugby-sevens-team-upsets-australia-win-bronze-medal-walk-off-fashion (Fox News)]
